newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.4 bln for Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.4 bln for Oct 30.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $1.436 billion in 39 offerings for Wednesday, October 30, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $392 million in 21 offerings, with a $132 million Virginia Public School Authority offering at 1100 EST the largest offering.

Negotiated sales total $1.144 billion in 18 offerings. The largest issue is a $595 million New York State Urban Development Corp issue structured as senior and junior lien revenue bonds through PaineWebber Inc.
An additional three negotiated deals totaling $66 million are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar for Wednesday, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues depending on market conditions.
